fuente.titulo: Pope: Mary is ‘safe refuge’ amidst life’s difficulties

titular: Pope Leo XIV calls Mary a refuge in hard times
bajada: At General Audience, he renews appeal to pray the Rosary for peace this October
caption: At this week's General Audience, Pope Leo XIV described Mary as a 'safe refuge' amid life's difficulties and renewed his invitation to pray the Rosary, echoing an appeal he made earlier in Lourdes for peace in the world. Source: Vatican News, Oct 7, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: St. Peter's Square during a general audience, the pope seen from a distance at a podium in the upper right third, open space left and center, soft morning light
